prompt:
A line-art multi-panel storyboard of one continuous scene of a live-action short drama: one image divided into a grid of 3 columns and 4 rows of equal 9:16 panels, 10 panels read from left to right and top to bottom; cells after the last panel stay plain white. Every panel is a colouring-book drawing: contours only, in one thin uniform black line on white, most of the panel left white. Draw only the people and the few large shapes of the place (walls, doors, windows, a bed, a car). People are simple storyboard figures: hair is one smooth outline of its shape, like a cap, empty inside, with no strands, curls or waves; a face has one short line each for the eyes, brows, nose and mouth, and no stubble, wrinkles or jaw lines; a fence is its posts and top rail, a tree its outline. No texture, mesh, bricks, leaves or fabric folds; no shading, grey or solid black: dark hair, clothes and cars are outlines left white inside. Thin black panel borders, plain white gutters. Location: INT. JI RAN'S APARTMENT ENTRANCE, Night, warm interior light from brass sconces and ceiling downlights, turning soft and glowing at the end.
Image 1: the character sheet of Lu Shaoze (28), look S1
Image 2: the character sheet of Ji Ran (27), look S3
Image 3: the character sheet of Lin Qingyu (21), look S2
Image 4: the location INT. JI RAN'S APARTMENT ENTRANCE, the front view, the establishing view, facing the back wall, with no people
Image 5: the location INT. JI RAN'S APARTMENT ENTRANCE, the back view, turned 180 degrees, facing the front wall, with the left wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 6: the location INT. JI RAN'S APARTMENT ENTRANCE, the left-side view, facing the left wall, with the back wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 7: the location INT. JI RAN'S APARTMENT ENTRANCE, the right-side view, facing the right wall, with the back wall at its left edge, with no people
Image 8: the location INT. JI RAN'S APARTMENT ENTRANCE, the floor plan seen from above: its top edge is the back wall, its bottom edge the front wall behind the front view's camera, and its left and right edges the left and right walls, with no people
Image 9: the blocking reference of this segment, the same place with its people in their places at the start; use it only for where each person is and which way they face, and keep each person on that seat or spot, on the same side of the room, in every panel until a shot moves them; do not copy its colours or light
Image 10: the prop black handbag; use only structure, material, and color
Image 11: the prop grocery bag full of greens; use only structure, material, and color
Draw each character so they can be told apart as in their reference image, by the shape of the hairstyle, the build and the outfit in outline only; never copy the photograph's detail. Use the character sheets only for the characters, not for their layout, white background or multiple views. Use the location images only for the layout of the space and the place of its furniture and props, drawn in outline. There is only one of each vehicle, piece of furniture and prop that the location shows, defined by the location images, throughout all panels; when a panel shows only part of one, such as a car's hood, it is that same object, and no second one appears. Each panel shows only the characters it names, and nobody appears twice in one panel.
At the start: Ji Ran stands beneath the autumn landscape painting on the elevator side of the console table, holding the black handbag, jaw set. Lu Shaoze stands close to her beneath the painting on the front-door side, leaning toward her, facing her and the elevator doors. The elevator doors are closed. Camera on the corridor side, facing the painting.
Panel 1: Medium shot two-shot, locked-off camera, eye level, from the corridor end facing the painting. Lu Shaoze taps his own chest proudly with two fingers, facing Ji Ran beneath the painting.
Panel 2: Medium close-up, low angle, slow push in on Lu Shaoze, from the corridor end on the elevator side. Lu Shaoze raises his chin and adjusts the peaked lapel of his navy double-breasted suit jacket with a self-satisfied smile.
Panel 3: Medium shot, over-the-shoulder shot past Ji Ran's shoulder, from the corridor end on the elevator side, facing Lu Shaoze. Lu Shaoze leans in with a smirk and gives a short smug snort.
Panel 4: Medium shot two-shot, handheld camera, eye level, from the corridor end facing the painting. Lu Shaoze reaches a hand toward Ji Ran's shoulder and she stiffens. Behind her, the elevator doors on the left wall slide open.
Panel 5: Close-up, low angle near the floor, tracking forward from the elevator doors toward the painting. Lin Qingyu's white sneakers stride out of the elevator across the pale stone floor toward Ji Ran, the grocery bag full of greens swinging from one hand, bok choy and spring onions spilling from its top.
Panel 6: Medium shot three-shot, locked-off camera, eye level, from the corridor end facing the painting. Lin Qingyu steps in beside Ji Ran on the elevator side, slips his free arm protectively around her waist and faces Lu Shaoze, the grocery bag full of greens held in his other hand. Lu Shaoze's reaching hand freezes in midair.
Panel 7: Medium close-up, dirty single on Lin Qingyu with Ji Ran's shoulder in the foreground, locked-off camera, eye level, from the corridor end on the front-door side. Lin Qingyu tilts his head toward Ji Ran with a sweet dimpled smile while his eyes stay cool on Lu Shaoze, the leafy top of the grocery bag at his side.
Panel 8: Medium close-up, clean single on Lu Shaoze, locked-off camera, eye level, from the corridor end on the elevator side. Lu Shaoze slowly lowers his hand, his face frozen in disbelief.
Panel 9: Close-up, slight low angle, locked-off camera, from the corridor end on the front-door side. Ji Ran looks up at Lin Qingyu in surprise, her fingers loosening on the black handbag, his arm around her waist.
Panel 10: Wide shot, slow pull out from the three, eye level, from the corridor end facing the painting. Ji Ran and Lin Qingyu stand together beneath the autumn landscape painting on the elevator side, his arm around her waist and the grocery bag full of greens in his other hand, facing Lu Shaoze on the front-door side. Soft glowing light blooms and drifting flakes float through the landing.
Keep the characters, the number and position of every vehicle, piece of furniture and prop, and the location's spatial orientation consistent across all panels.
No text, letters, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, panel labels or watermark anywhere in the image; no photographic rendering.
